# Setup

```{r, include = FALSE}

#To clear the workspace
rm(list = ls(all = T))

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy = TRUE, message=FALSE)

# My theme
theme.dgm <- function () {
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
}

theme.dgm.map <- function (){
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) 
}
```

# Clean up AFDM

```{r}

AFDM_raw <- read_excel(here("01_raw_data", "LS_AFDM.xlsx"))

AFDM_clean <- AFDM_raw %>%
  group_by(SeaStar_ID) %>%
  summarize(Dry_mass_g = sum(Dry_mass_g),
            Ash_mass_g = sum(Ash_mass_g),
            AFDM_g = sum(AFDM_g), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(AFDM_clean, here("03_cleaned_data", "AFDM_clean.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```


```{r, include = FALSE}
#Build data frame to hold new metabolic data

meta_record <- read_excel(here("01_raw_data", "LS_Experiment_Data.xlsx"),
                          sheet = "Meta_Assignments") %>%
  mutate(Tank_Temp_C = as.numeric(Tank_Temp_C),
         Meta_Temp_C = as.numeric(Meta_Temp_C),
         ID = case_when(
           ID == "NA" ~ NA,
           .default = ID
         ),
         Food_Treatment = case_when(
           Food_Treatment == "NA" ~ NA,
           .default = Food_Treatment
         ))

phys_char <- read_excel(here("01_raw_data", "LS_Physical_Characteristics.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(V_SS_Water = as.numeric(V_SS_Water),
         V_Water = as.numeric(V_Water),
         V_SS = as.numeric(V_SS)) %>%
  filter(is.na(Treatment_Code) == FALSE) %>%
  left_join(AFDM_clean, by = join_by(ID == SeaStar_ID))

meta_rates <- as.data.frame(matrix(data = NA, ncol = 11, nrow = 64)) 
colnames(meta_rates) <- c("Seastar_ID", "Food_Treatment", "Tank_Treatment", "Meta_Treatment", 
                          "Sampling_Day", "Salinity", "SS_Vol_ml", "SS_mass_g", "mass_spec_O2", "r_2", 
                          "Vol_abso_O2")

```

```{r}

for(i in 2:9){
  
  df_x <- get(paste("Feb18_Tank15C_Meta20C_Chan", i, "_clean", sep =""))
  
  ss_meta_notes <- meta_record %>%
    filter(Date_Meta == as.Date("2025-02-18") &
           Round_Meta == "R1" & 
           Channel == paste("Ch", i, sep =""))
  
  phys_char_xx <- phys_char %>%
    filter(ID == ss_meta_notes$ID)
  
  print(paste("Feb18_Tank15C_Meta20C_Chan", i, "_clean", sep =""))
  print(df_x %>% inspect(., plot=TRUE))
  
  xx_mean_bg <- mean(c(calc_rate.bg(Feb18_Tank15C_Meta20C_Chan1_clean)$rate.bg, 
                       calc_rate.bg(Feb18_Tank15C_Meta20C_Chan10_clean)$rate.bg))
  
  xx_converted_mass <- df_x %>%                                                     
    calc_rate() %>%
    adjust_rate(xx_mean_bg) %>%
    convert_rate(oxy.unit = "%Air", 
                 time.unit = "m",     
                 output.unit = "ml/h/g", 
                 volume = phys_char_xx$V_SS, 
                 mass = phys_char_xx$AFDM_g, 
                 S=30.5, 
                 t=ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C)
  
  
   xx_converted_vol <- df_x %>%                                                     
    calc_rate() %>%
    adjust_rate(xx_mean_bg) %>%
    convert_rate(oxy.unit = "%Air", 
                 time.unit = "m",     
                 output.unit = "ml/h", 
                 volume = phys_char_xx$V_SS, 
                 S=30.5, 
                 t=ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C)
    
  meta_rates$Seastar_ID[i-1] <- ss_meta_notes$ID
  meta_rates$Food_Treatment[i-1] <- ss_meta_notes$Food_Treatment
  meta_rates$Tank_Treatment[i-1] <- ss_meta_notes$Tank_Temp_C
  meta_rates$Meta_Treatment[i-1] <- ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C
  meta_rates$Sampling_Day[i-1] <- phys_char_xx$Sampling_Day_Treatment
  meta_rates$Salinity[i-1] <- 30.5
  meta_rates$SS_Vol_ml[i-1] <- phys_char_xx$V_SS
  meta_rates$SS_mass_g[i-1] <- phys_char_xx$AFDM_g
  meta_rates$mass_spec_O2[i-1] <- xx_converted_mass$rate.output
  meta_rates$r_2[i-1] <- calc_rate(df_x)$summary$rsq
  meta_rates$Vol_abso_O2[i-1] <- xx_converted_vol$rate.output
}

```

```{r}

for(i in 2:9){
  
  df_x <- get(paste("Feb18_Tank15C_Meta15C_Chan", i, "_clean", sep =""))
  
  ss_meta_notes <- meta_record %>%
    filter(Date_Meta == as.Date("2025-02-18") &
           Round_Meta == "R2" & 
           Channel == paste("Ch", i, sep =""))
  
  phys_char_xx <- phys_char %>%
    filter(ID == ss_meta_notes$ID)
  
  print(paste("Feb18_Tank15C_Meta15C_Chan", i, "_clean", sep =""))
  print(df_x %>% inspect(., plot=TRUE))
  
  xx_mean_bg <- mean(c(calc_rate.bg(Feb18_Tank15C_Meta15C_Chan1_clean)$rate.bg, 
                       calc_rate.bg(Feb18_Tank15C_Meta15C_Chan10_clean)$rate.bg))
  
  xx_converted_mass <- df_x %>%                                                     
    calc_rate() %>%
    adjust_rate(xx_mean_bg) %>%
    convert_rate(oxy.unit = "%Air", 
                 time.unit = "m",     
                 output.unit = "ml/h/g", 
                 volume = phys_char_xx$V_SS, 
                 mass = phys_char_xx$AFDM_g, 
                 S=30.5, 
                 t=ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C)
  
  
   xx_converted_vol <- df_x %>%                                                     
    calc_rate() %>%
    adjust_rate(xx_mean_bg) %>%
    convert_rate(oxy.unit = "%Air", 
                 time.unit = "m",     
                 output.unit = "ml/h", 
                 volume = phys_char_xx$V_SS, 
                 S=30.2, 
                 t=ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C)
    
  meta_rates$Seastar_ID[i+7] <- ss_meta_notes$ID
  meta_rates$Food_Treatment[i+7] <- ss_meta_notes$Food_Treatment
  meta_rates$Tank_Treatment[i+7] <- ss_meta_notes$Tank_Temp_C
  meta_rates$Meta_Treatment[i+7] <- ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C
  meta_rates$Sampling_Day[i+7] <- phys_char_xx$Sampling_Day_Treatment
  meta_rates$Salinity[i+7] <- 30.2
  meta_rates$SS_Vol_ml[i+7] <- phys_char_xx$V_SS
  meta_rates$SS_mass_g[i+7] <- phys_char_xx$AFDM_g
  meta_rates$mass_spec_O2[i+7] <- xx_converted_mass$rate.output
  meta_rates$r_2[i+7] <- calc_rate(df_x)$summary$rsq
  meta_rates$Vol_abso_O2[i+7] <- xx_converted_vol$rate.output
}

```

```{r}

for(i in 2:9){
  
  df_x <- get(paste("Feb18_Tank10C_Meta10C_Chan", i, "_clean", sep =""))
  
  ss_meta_notes <- meta_record %>%
    filter(Date_Meta == as.Date("2025-02-18") &
           Round_Meta == "R4" & 
           Channel == paste("Ch", i, sep =""))
  
  phys_char_xx <- phys_char %>%
    filter(ID == ss_meta_notes$ID)
  
  print(paste("Feb18_Tank10C_Meta10C_Chan", i, "_clean", sep =""))
  print(df_x %>% inspect(., plot=TRUE))
  
  xx_mean_bg <- mean(c(calc_rate.bg(Feb18_Tank10C_Meta10C_Chan1_clean)$rate.bg, 
                       calc_rate.bg(Feb18_Tank10C_Meta10C_Chan10_clean)$rate.bg))
  
  xx_converted_mass <- df_x %>%                                                     
    calc_rate() %>%
    adjust_rate(xx_mean_bg) %>%
    convert_rate(oxy.unit = "%Air", 
                 time.unit = "m",     
                 output.unit = "ml/h/g", 
                 volume = phys_char_xx$V_SS, 
                 mass = phys_char_xx$AFDM_g, 
                 S=30.5, 
                 t=ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C)
  
  
   xx_converted_vol <- df_x %>%                                                     
    calc_rate() %>%
    adjust_rate(xx_mean_bg) %>%
    convert_rate(oxy.unit = "%Air", 
                 time.unit = "m",     
                 output.unit = "ml/h", 
                 volume = phys_char_xx$V_SS, 
                 S=30.2, 
                 t=ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C)
    
  meta_rates$Seastar_ID[i+23] <- ss_meta_notes$ID
  meta_rates$Food_Treatment[i+23] <- ss_meta_notes$Food_Treatment
  meta_rates$Tank_Treatment[i+23] <- ss_meta_notes$Tank_Temp_C
  meta_rates$Meta_Treatment[i+23] <- ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C
  meta_rates$Sampling_Day[i+23] <- phys_char_xx$Sampling_Day_Treatment
  meta_rates$Salinity[i+23] <- 30.2
  meta_rates$SS_Vol_ml[i+23] <- phys_char_xx$V_SS
  meta_rates$SS_mass_g[i+23] <- phys_char_xx$AFDM_g
  meta_rates$mass_spec_O2[i+23] <- xx_converted_mass$rate.output
  meta_rates$r_2[i+23] <- calc_rate(df_x)$summary$rsq
  meta_rates$Vol_abso_O2[i+23] <- xx_converted_vol$rate.output
}
```

```{r}

for(i in 2:9){
  
  df_x <- get(paste("Feb19_Tank15C_Meta20C_Chan", i, "_clean", sep =""))
  
  ss_meta_notes <- meta_record %>%
    filter(Date_Meta == as.Date("2025-02-19") &
           Round_Meta == "R5" & 
           Channel == paste("Ch", i, sep =""))
  
  phys_char_xx <- phys_char %>%
    filter(ID == ss_meta_notes$ID)
  
  print(paste("Feb19_Tank15C_Meta20C_Chan", i, "_clean", sep =""))
  print(df_x %>% inspect(., plot=TRUE))
  
  xx_mean_bg <- mean(c(calc_rate.bg(Feb19_Tank15C_Meta20C_Chan1_clean)$rate.bg, 
                       calc_rate.bg(Feb19_Tank15C_Meta20C_Chan10_clean)$rate.bg))
  
  xx_converted_mass <- df_x %>%                                                     
    calc_rate() %>%
    adjust_rate(xx_mean_bg) %>%
    convert_rate(oxy.unit = "%Air", 
                 time.unit = "m",     
                 output.unit = "ml/h/g", 
                 volume = phys_char_xx$V_SS, 
                 mass = phys_char_xx$AFDM_g, 
                 S=30.5, 
                 t=ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C)
  
  
   xx_converted_vol <- df_x %>%                                                     
    calc_rate() %>%
    adjust_rate(xx_mean_bg) %>%
    convert_rate(oxy.unit = "%Air", 
                 time.unit = "m",     
                 output.unit = "ml/h", 
                 volume = phys_char_xx$V_SS, 
                 S=30.2, 
                 t=ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C)
    
  meta_rates$Seastar_ID[i+31] <- ss_meta_notes$ID
  meta_rates$Food_Treatment[i+31] <- ss_meta_notes$Food_Treatment
  meta_rates$Tank_Treatment[i+31] <- ss_meta_notes$Tank_Temp_C
  meta_rates$Meta_Treatment[i+31] <- ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C
  meta_rates$Sampling_Day[i+31] <- phys_char_xx$Sampling_Day_Treatment
  meta_rates$Salinity[i+31] <- 30.2
  meta_rates$SS_Vol_ml[i+31] <- phys_char_xx$V_SS
  meta_rates$SS_mass_g[i+31] <- phys_char_xx$AFDM_g
  meta_rates$mass_spec_O2[i+31] <- xx_converted_mass$rate.output
  meta_rates$r_2[i+31] <- calc_rate(df_x)$summary$rsq
  meta_rates$Vol_abso_O2[i+31] <- xx_converted_vol$rate.output
}
```

```{r}

for(i in 2:9){
  
  df_x <- get(paste("Feb19_Tank10C_Meta15C_Chan", i, "_clean", sep =""))
  
  ss_meta_notes <- meta_record %>%
    filter(Date_Meta == as.Date("2025-02-19") &
           Round_Meta == "R7" & 
           Channel == paste("Ch", i, sep =""))
  
  phys_char_xx <- phys_char %>%
    filter(ID == ss_meta_notes$ID)
  
  print(paste("Feb19_Tank10C_Meta15C_Chan", i, "_clean", sep =""))
  print(df_x %>% inspect(., plot=TRUE))
  
  xx_mean_bg <- mean(c(calc_rate.bg(Feb19_Tank10C_Meta15C_Chan1_clean)$rate.bg, 
                       calc_rate.bg(Feb19_Tank10C_Meta15C_Chan10_clean)$rate.bg))
  
  xx_converted_mass <- df_x %>%                                                     
    calc_rate() %>%
    adjust_rate(xx_mean_bg) %>%
    convert_rate(oxy.unit = "%Air", 
                 time.unit = "m",     
                 output.unit = "ml/h/g", 
                 volume = phys_char_xx$V_SS, 
                 mass = phys_char_xx$AFDM_g, 
                 S=30.5, 
                 t=ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C)
  
  
   xx_converted_vol <- df_x %>%                                                     
    calc_rate() %>%
    adjust_rate(xx_mean_bg) %>%
    convert_rate(oxy.unit = "%Air", 
                 time.unit = "m",     
                 output.unit = "ml/h", 
                 volume = phys_char_xx$V_SS, 
                 S=30.2, 
                 t=ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C)
    
  meta_rates$Seastar_ID[i+47] <- ss_meta_notes$ID
  meta_rates$Food_Treatment[i+47] <- ss_meta_notes$Food_Treatment
  meta_rates$Tank_Treatment[i+47] <- ss_meta_notes$Tank_Temp_C
  meta_rates$Meta_Treatment[i+47] <- ss_meta_notes$Meta_Temp_C
  meta_rates$Sampling_Day[i+47] <- phys_char_xx$Sampling_Day_Treatment
  meta_rates$Salinity[i+47] <- 30.2
  meta_rates$SS_Vol_ml[i+47] <- phys_char_xx$V_SS
  meta_rates$SS_mass_g[i+47] <- phys_char_xx$AFDM_g
  meta_rates$mass_spec_O2[i+47] <- xx_converted_mass$rate.output
  meta_rates$r_2[i+47] <- calc_rate(df_x)$summary$rsq
  meta_rates$Vol_abso_O2[i+47] <- xx_converted_vol$rate.output
}
```
